title: Fourteen million plays of Snapchat lenses

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fourteen million plays. That's the all-time total from Antoine's Snapchat lenses, according to Lens Insights.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Fourteen million? From a side project?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It started as jokes for friends in 2017. By 2020 he'd shipped forty-two lenses, for himself and for clients, and had a small Fiverr business on the side.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Go Crazy Facetime at roughly 2.9 million plays, Face Ghosting around 1.2 million, and BIG SMILE around 520 thousand.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Brief, prototype, review, delivery. He sent a screen recording before polishing anything. And he kept a reject checklist: licensed audio, a thumbnail readable at phone size, effects that trigger on the right face region, and a ten-second preview that shows the hook.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: He says it saved more client arguments than any shader tweak. The hardest projects were the ones that said make it viral, with no creative direction.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: He also wrote a small tool that turns GIFs or videos into PNG sequences for Lens Studio. Other creators picked it up.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And Snapchat even phoned him to collect Lens Studio feedback.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: His takeaway is that this was his first experience shipping creative work to millions of anonymous users with real analytics. Closer to product than portfolio art.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The full write-up has the numbers and what he wants to try next on Meta Spark.
